measurement_method: 人工锁定地面左/前/右角横坐标，alpha>=200该列最下边界定位纵坐标；端点不确定度±4源像素。补充完整可见边缘鲁棒直线拟合（排除入口凸出的台阶及离主边>6px点）；不挑有利局部。

candidate_records.prompt: Repaint the exact reference shape into a fine realistic historical game sprite: Ming Jiangnan biaoju goods depot courtyard, white plaster enclosure and dark gray tiled caps, chestnut timber low hall to rear and two little storage sheds. A wooden gate halfway down left-front wall; some cargo crates and covered cart INSIDE yard. No exterior steps. Photorealistic ancient Chinese miniature architecture, individual delicate roof tiles, woodgrain, subtly worn stone, restrained warm daylight upper left. A city map building isolated on true transparent alpha. Keep the four lower corners where they are; preserve contour and do not enlarge/reframe/recenter. Both visible base edges must be 2:1 slopes (+0.5 and -0.5); ground footprint15m wide by12m deep. Maintain verticals vertical and opposite sides parallel; no perspective convergence. No thick platform. Full complete roofs with clear margins. No diagram lines, grid, text, signs, people, modern objects, halo, backdrop or painted checkerboard.
candidate_records.rejection_reason: 双轴/占地比未同时通过，不能作为已验收素材
